name: munder-difflin-blog
description: The Munder Difflin blog — built with Eleventy, deployed to munderdiffl.in/blog via GitHub Pages.

scripts.build: npm run clean && eleventy && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.preview:sunroom: rimraf ../docs/blog-preview-sunroom && BLOG_THEME=sunroom BLOG_PREVIEW=1 BLOG_BASE=/blog-preview-sunroom BLOG_OUT=../docs/blog-preview-sunroom eleventy
scripts.preview:press: rimraf ../docs/blog-preview-press && BLOG_THEME=press BLOG_PREVIEW=1 BLOG_BASE=/blog-preview-press BLOG_OUT=../docs/blog-preview-press eleventy
scripts.previews: npm run preview:sunroom && npm run preview:press
